listing.name: Tenchu Z — Tenchu Z Recomp (8bitninja64)
listing.summary: Upstream boots/movies/audio/menus/hideout/missions with native D3D11 at the original 30 FPS and 60 FPS or higher options. New HDR10/AO/sharpening/MSAA8x/controller settings/cheats are feature claims; wider than 16:9 and achievements unfinished. the existing 75–80 FPS mission example on an RTX 3070 laptop is upstream-only; no full campaign or Portcove gameplay qualification. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own TenchuZ USA/Europe EnFrDeEsIt disc default.xex SHA256 c727debeaad474dfcf8517202eebc388f9e51705ce3b01499486fa5ff47f9f06; XDK2.0.4552. Own ISO or extracted disc folder remains runtime data.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Download upstream TenchuZ-windows-x64.zip; install Python3.11+ and VS2022 BuildTools C++/Clang as documented. First start selects own supported ISO and locally generates/compiles tenchu_game.dll; original ISO stays required/read in place. Source tools/build.ps1 route remains. Upstream adds optional Esc settings > Update self-update with SHA256 checks and preserved saves/module; manual unzip-over update remains. Neither updater nor package executed by Portcove.
